nodes.label: dq_removed_rows table
nodes.rationale: Every removed row logged with a reason; check confirms raw = clean + removed.

nodes.label: Exact Duplicate Removal
nodes.rationale: A customer can't produce the same row with identical balances twice, so these are load artifacts; keep first copy.

nodes.label: AML_Fraud_Monitoring.twb Tableau Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Workbook stores absolute path to 03_tableau/data, so build_twb.py must be rerun if project moves.

nodes.label: isFlaggedFraud (operator's old flag)
nodes.rationale: Single fixed-amount rule catching only 16 of ~8,200 fraud cases (~0.2%); motivates explainable multi-rule approach.

nodes.label: PaySim Dataset
nodes.rationale: Synthetic because real bank transactions aren't public; has fraud labels which makes measuring rules possible.

nodes.label: Risk Score (alert at >= 50)
nodes.rationale: Rules only use TRANSFER and CASH_OUT (only types with fraud) and never use the fraud label; each alert shows which rules it hit.

nodes.label: Near-Duplicate Flagging (structuring signal)
nodes.rationale: Repeated payments may be structuring, so they are kept and flagged rather than deleted.
